description: Defines the NuPlayer class for media playback control in Android, including methods for setting data sources, starting, pausing, resuming, and handling various media events.

classes.name: NuPlayer
classes.description: Main class for media playback, managing data sources, decoders, rendering, and media control.

methods.name: setUID
methods.description: Sets the user ID for the player.

methods.name: setDriver
methods.description: Associates a driver with the player.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the media data source, either via stream, URL, or file descriptor.

methods.name: setVideoSurfaceTexture
methods.description: Sets the surface texture for video output.

methods.name: setAudioSink
methods.description: Sets the audio sink for playback.

methods.name: seekToAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeks to a specified position.
